candidates.source: 金星老儿老是一套招安招安 天庭威严被他丢尽
candidates.target: The old man Venus is always trying to appease the heavens, but he's lost all their dignity.

candidates.source: 金星老儿老是一套招安招安 天庭威严被他丢尽
candidates.target: The Venus Elder is always on about pardons and amnesty, he's completely ruined the Heavenly Court's dignity.

candidates.source: 金星老儿老是一套招安招安 天庭威严被他丢尽
candidates.target: Old Jin Xing always uses the same old tricks of pacification and surrender. He has completely disregarded the majesty of Heaven.

candidates.source: 金星老儿老是一套招安招安 天庭威严被他丢尽
candidates.target: Jin Xing Lao Er is a set of “Zha’an, Zha’an” – Heaven’s majesty was completely discarded by him.

candidates.source: 金星老儿老是一套招安招安 天庭威严被他丢尽
candidates.target: Old Venus always resorts to the same tactic of co-optation; he has utterly squandered the majesty of the Heavenly Court.

candidates.source: 金星老儿老是一套招安招安 天庭威严被他丢尽
candidates.target: The old Venusian is set on pacification and pacification; he has utterly discarded the majesty of the Heavenly Court.

candidates.source: 金星老儿老是一套招安招安 天庭威严被他丢尽
candidates.target: Old Jin Xing always resorts to amnesty; he has utterly disgraced the majesty of the Heavenly Court.

candidates.source: 金星老儿老是一套招安招安 天庭威严被他丢尽
candidates.target: He's loosening Heaven's laws.

candidates.source: 启奏万岁 今有妖猴孙悟空 蛮横无理 大闹龙宫 拔去我镇海之宝
candidates.target: Your Majesty, there is a demon monkey named Sun Wukong who has been acting rampantly and causing chaos in the Dragon Palace, plucking away my treasure that guards the sea.

candidates.source: 启奏万岁 今有妖猴孙悟空 蛮横无理 大闹龙宫 拔去我镇海之宝
candidates.target: To the Immortal Emperor, I report: A rebellious monkey, Sun Wukong, has acted outrageously and disrupted the Dragon Palace, stealing the treasured artifact that secures the seas.

candidates.source: 启奏万岁 今有妖猴孙悟空 蛮横无理 大闹龙宫 拔去我镇海之宝
candidates.target: Reporting to Your Majesty, there is a demonic monkey, Sun Wukong, who is unruly and unreasonable. He has caused a great disturbance in the Dragon Palace and uprooted my treasured pearl that calms the seas.

candidates.source: 启奏万岁 今有妖猴孙悟空 蛮横无理 大闹龙宫 拔去我镇海之宝
candidates.target: I prostrate myself before the Emperor for eternity. Today, there is a mischievous monkey, Sun Wukong, acting wildly and causing chaos in the Dragon Palace, and he has stolen my treasure, the Jewel of the Seas.

candidates.source: 启奏万岁 今有妖猴孙悟空 蛮横无理 大闹龙宫 拔去我镇海之宝
candidates.target: Your Majesty, I humbly report that the demonic monkey Sun Wukong, acting with insolence and lawlessness, has caused chaos in the Dragon Palace and uprooted our treasure that calms the seas.

candidates.source: 启奏万岁 今有妖猴孙悟空 蛮横无理 大闹龙宫 拔去我镇海之宝
candidates.target: Report to the Emperor: There is a demon monkey named Sun Wukong, who is arrogant and unreasonable. He has caused a great disturbance in the Dragon Palace and plucked my treasure that calms the sea.

candidates.source: 启奏万岁 今有妖猴孙悟空 蛮横无理 大闹龙宫 拔去我镇海之宝
candidates.target: Your Majesty, I report that the demon monkey Sun Wukong has acted arrogantly and without reason, causing a disturbance in the Dragon Palace and plucking out my treasure that calms the sea.

candidates.source: 启奏万岁 今有妖猴孙悟空 蛮横无理 大闹龙宫 拔去我镇海之宝
candidates.target: Your majesty, the monkey Sun Wukong outrageously made havoc in my Palace, and robbed me of my Gold Cudgel, which is used to calm the sea.

candidates.source: 万岁 贫道为万岁所炼的九转金丹 被那个孙悟空偷吃得一干二净
candidates.target: Long live the Emperor! The nine-turn golden pill that I, the humble Daoist, refined for your majesty has been stolen clean by that Sun Wukong.

candidates.source: 万岁 贫道为万岁所炼的九转金丹 被那个孙悟空偷吃得一干二净
candidates.target: Long live! This poor monk's Nine Transformation Golden Pill, refined for the Emperor, was completely stolen and eaten by that Sun Wukong.

candidates.source: 万岁 贫道为万岁所炼的九转金丹 被那个孙悟空偷吃得一干二净
candidates.target: Long live the Emperor! The Nine-Turn Golden Elixir that I, a humble Taoist, refined for His Majesty was completely stolen and devoured by that Sun Wukong!

candidates.source: 万岁 贫道为万岁所炼的九转金丹 被那个孙悟空偷吃得一干二净
candidates.target: Long live! The poor Daoist was refining a nine-turn golden elixir for the Great Emperor, and that Sun Wukong stole and devoured it completely.

candidates.source: 万岁 贫道为万岁所炼的九转金丹 被那个孙悟空偷吃得一干二净
candidates.target: Long live the Emperor! The Nine-Revolution Golden Elixir that this humble Daoist prepared for Your Majesty has been entirely stolen and consumed by that Sun Wukong.

candidates.source: 万岁 贫道为万岁所炼的九转金丹 被那个孙悟空偷吃得一干二净
candidates.target: Your Majesty, the Nine-Transform Golden Pill that I, a Daoist, forged for Your Majesty has been completely stolen and consumed by that Monkey King, Sun Wukong.

candidates.source: 万岁 贫道为万岁所炼的九转金丹 被那个孙悟空偷吃得一干二净
candidates.target: Long live the Emperor! The Nine-Turn Golden Pill that I, a humble Daoist, forged for Your Majesty has been completely stolen and consumed by that Sun Wukong.

candidates.source: 万岁 贫道为万岁所炼的九转金丹 被那个孙悟空偷吃得一干二净
candidates.target: Your Majesty, Sun Wukong ate up all of the Golden Elixir Pills I made for you.

candidates.source: 那弼马温在花果山挂起旗号 自称齐天大圣 还要与万岁平起平坐
candidates.target: The horse-tamer raised his flag on Mount Huaguo, proclaimed himself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven, and even demanded to sit on an equal footing with the Emperor.

candidates.source: 那弼马温在花果山挂起旗号 自称齐天大圣 还要与万岁平起平坐
candidates.target: That buffoon on Peach Blossom Mountain raised a banner, declaring himself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven and demanding to be on par with the Eternal.

candidates.source: 那弼马温在花果山挂起旗号 自称齐天大圣 还要与万岁平起平坐
candidates.target: That Sun Wukong raised his banner on Flower Fruit Mountain, proclaimed himself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven, and even wanted to be on equal footing with the Emperor.

candidates.source: 那弼马温在花果山挂起旗号 自称齐天大圣 还要与万岁平起平坐
candidates.target: Then, Bi Ma Wen hung up his banner, proclaiming himself the Great Sage of Heaven, and insisted on sitting at the same level as the Emperor.

candidates.source: 那弼马温在花果山挂起旗号 自称齐天大圣 还要与万岁平起平坐
candidates.target: That Bimawen raised his banner on Flower-Fruit Mountain, proclaimed himself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven, and demanded to sit on equal footing with Your Majesty.

candidates.source: 那弼马温在花果山挂起旗号 自称齐天大圣 还要与万岁平起平坐
candidates.target: Then Bi Ma Wen raised the banner at Flower-Fruit Mountain, declaring himself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven, and demanding to sit at the same level as the Son of Heaven.

candidates.source: 那弼马温在花果山挂起旗号 自称齐天大圣 还要与万岁平起平坐
candidates.target: That Bi Ma Wen raised a banner at Flower Fruit Mountain, proclaimed himself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven, and demanded to sit on equal footing with the Emperor.

candidates.source: 那弼马温在花果山挂起旗号 自称齐天大圣 还要与万岁平起平坐
candidates.target: The Stable Keeper put up a banner at the Mountain of Flowers and Fruits declaring himself 'Great Sage Equal of Heaven'.

candidates.source: 玉帝老儿 你眼里没有俺齐天大圣 如今俺老孙倒坐了个首席
candidates.target: The Jade Emperor, you have no eyes for the Great Sage Equaling Heaven. Now, old Sun has taken the seat of honor.

candidates.source: 玉帝老儿 你眼里没有俺齐天大圣 如今俺老孙倒坐了个首席
candidates.target: Son of the Jade Emperor, you don't see me,齐 Tian Dasheng? Now I, your old Sun, have taken the chief seat.

candidates.source: 玉帝老儿 你眼里没有俺齐天大圣 如今俺老孙倒坐了个首席
candidates.target: Jade Emperor, you don't have me, the Great Sage Equal to Heaven, in your eyes! Now, I, your old Sun Wukong, have been given the first seat!

candidates.source: 玉帝老儿 你眼里没有俺齐天大圣 如今俺老孙倒坐了个首席
candidates.target: Old Emperor Jade, you don't see me, Sun Wukong, the Great Sage of the West. Now, I, your old grandson, have been seated as First in Command.

candidates.source: 玉帝老儿 你眼里没有俺齐天大圣 如今俺老孙倒坐了个首席
candidates.target: Old Jade Emperor, you never held the Great Sage Equal to Heaven in your eyes. Now, I, Old Sun, have taken the seat of honor.

candidates.source: 玉帝老儿 你眼里没有俺齐天大圣 如今俺老孙倒坐了个首席
candidates.target: Old Jade Emperor, you have no regard for me, the Great Sage Equal to Heaven. Now, I, Old Sun, have taken the top seat.

candidates.source: 玉帝老儿 你眼里没有俺齐天大圣 如今俺老孙倒坐了个首席
candidates.target: Old Sky Emperor, you have no eyes for me, the Great Sage Equal to Heaven. Now, I, Old Sun, sit in the prime seat.

candidates.source: 玉帝老儿 你眼里没有俺齐天大圣 如今俺老孙倒坐了个首席
candidates.target: Old Jade Emperor, you keep mocking me, the Great Sage, Equal of Heaven. But I'm going to sit on your throne today, here in the Peach Banquet.

candidates.source: 自从弼马温来此以后 天马 匹匹精壮驯服
candidates.target: Since the horse trainer came, every horse here has become strong and tame.

candidates.source: 自从弼马温来此以后 天马 匹匹精壮驯服
candidates.target: Since the groom arrived here, the horses have become strong, spirited, and well-trained.

candidates.source: 自从弼马温来此以后 天马 匹匹精壮驯服
candidates.target:
Since Bi Mawen arrived, the horses have all become strong, robust, and well-trained. 

(Note: Bi Mawen is a reference to Sun Wukong/The Monkey King in Journey to the West, who was initially given the title "Pima Wen" - Groom of the Heavenly Horses - and improved the horses' condition.)

candidates.source: 自从弼马温来此以后 天马 匹匹精壮驯服
candidates.target: Since Bi Ma Wen came here, the Pegasus has grown strong and docile.

candidates.source: 自从弼马温来此以后 天马 匹匹精壮驯服
candidates.target: Since the arrival of the Stable Keeper, every heavenly steed has become robust and well-tamed.

candidates.source: 自从弼马温来此以后 天马 匹匹精壮驯服
candidates.target: Since the Horse-Taming Official arrived here, every celestial steed has become vigorous, well-trained, and obedient.

candidates.source: 自从弼马温来此以后 天马 匹匹精壮驯服
candidates.target: Since Bi Ma Wen arrived, every heavenly steed has become strong, well-trained, and obedient.

candidates.source: 自从弼马温来此以后 天马 匹匹精壮驯服
candidates.target: Since you came here the Heaven horses have been very happy and comfortable.

candidates.source: 说什么在蟠桃会上吃 俺现在就吃 有何不可
candidates.target: What's wrong with eating now what we would eat at the banquet?

candidates.source: 说什么在蟠桃会上吃 俺现在就吃 有何不可
candidates.target: What are you saying about eating peaches at the Peach Banquet? I'll eat them now. What's wrong with that?

candidates.source: 说什么在蟠桃会上吃 俺现在就吃 有何不可
candidates.target:
What's so special about eating at the Peach Banquet? I'll eat now, what's wrong with that? 

(Or, more colloquially: "You say you only eat at the Peach Banquet? I'll eat now, what of it?") 

**Note:** The "蟠桃会" (Pántáo Huì) refers to a mythical peach banquet held by the Queen Mother of the West in Chinese mythology, where peaches of immortality are served. The phrase implies exclusivity and privilege. The speaker is challenging that exclusivity.

candidates.source: 说什么在蟠桃会上吃 俺现在就吃 有何不可
candidates.target: What’s wrong with me eating at the peach blossom festival? I’m eating now.

candidates.source: 说什么在蟠桃会上吃 俺现在就吃 有何不可
candidates.target: They say one eats at the Peach Banquet, but why not eat right now? What's wrong with that?

candidates.source: 说什么在蟠桃会上吃 俺现在就吃 有何不可
candidates.target: What's wrong with eating at the Panyao Banquet right now?

candidates.source: 说什么在蟠桃会上吃 俺现在就吃 有何不可
candidates.target: What? They say to eat at the Peach Banquet? I'll eat right now. What's wrong with that?

candidates.source: 说什么在蟠桃会上吃 俺现在就吃 有何不可
candidates.target: Why wait until the banquet when I can eat it right now?

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: It's me, Sun Wukong. I want to see the Old Dragon King. Please announce me quickly.

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: So it was the Turtle and the Shrimp! Old Sun Wukong is going to see the Dragon King. Quickly report this!

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: Turns out it's the Tortoise and Shrimp Generals. Old Sun wants to see the Dragon King! Quickly report it!

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: It turns out it’s the turtle, Shrimp Two, and Old Sun wants to see the Old Dragon King. Report quickly!

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: So it's the Turtle and the Shrimp Generals! I, the Great Sage, wish to see the Old Dragon King. Announce my presence at once!

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: It's the Tortoise and the Crab generals. I, Sun Wukong, wish to see the Dragon King. Inform him at once.

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: It's the turtle and shrimp generals! I, the Old Monkey, wish to see the Dragon King. Announce my arrival quickly!

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: So it's General Turtle and General Shrimp. I need to see the Dragon King. Please tell him quickly.

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: I, Sun Wukong, can go anywhere, whether in the heavens or underground. Where can't I go?

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: Old Sun, I, can do anything under and above the heavens; there's nowhere I can't go.

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: I, Sun Wukong, can go anywhere, both heaven and earth – there's no place I can't reach.

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: Old Sun can do anything, anywhere he goes.

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: I, Old Sun, can traverse heaven and earth with boundless power; is there any place I cannot go?

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: I am the Great Sage, capable of ascending to heaven and descending to earth; there is no place I cannot reach.

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: I, the Great Sage, can ascend to heaven and descend to earth; there is no place I cannot reach.

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: I can fly up to Heaven and burrow into the deepest ground. There's no place I can't go.

candidates.source: 哼 你有多 大本领 敢自称齐天大圣 先吃我一枪
candidates.target: Hmph, how dare you call yourself the Great Sage Equaling Heaven with such feeble skills? Let me give you a taste of my gun!

candidates.source: 哼 你有多 大本领 敢自称齐天大圣 先吃我一枪
candidates.target: Hmph, what qualifications do you have to call yourself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven? Take this shot first!

candidates.source: 哼 你有多 大本领 敢自称齐天大圣 先吃我一枪
candidates.target: Hmph, just how capable are you to dare call yourself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven? Eat this shot of mine first!

candidates.source: 哼 你有多 大本领 敢自称齐天大圣 先吃我一枪
candidates.target: Pah! How much power do you have to call yourself the Great Sage of Heaven? Shoot me first!

candidates.source: 哼 你有多 大本领 敢自称齐天大圣 先吃我一枪
candidates.target: Hmph! What power do you possess to dare call yourself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven? Take this spear thrust!

candidates.source: 哼 你有多 大本领 敢自称齐天大圣 先吃我一枪
candidates.target: Hmph! How dare you claim to be the Great Sage Equal to Heaven? Take this shot!

candidates.source: 哼 你有多 大本领 敢自称齐天大圣 先吃我一枪
candidates.target: Hmph! What qualifications do you have to call yourself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven? First, take this spear!

candidates.source: 哼 你有多 大本领 敢自称齐天大圣 先吃我一枪
candidates.target: Who are you to declare yourself The Great Sage? Eat this!

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: The power to subdue dragons and tigers, to move mountains and overturn seas, must never be underestimated.

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: With strength enough to subdue dragons and tigers, and move mountains and seas, long may you live, but never underestimate [this/it]!

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: Strength can subdue dragons and tigers, move mountains and overturn the seas. Long live [the emperor/a powerful figure], but must never be taken lightly!

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: Strength can subdue dragons and tigers, move mountains and overturn seas. A thousand years should not be disregarded!

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: His power can subdue dragons and tigers, move mountains, and overturn seas. Your Majesty must never underestimate him.

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: This power can subdue dragons and tigers, move mountains and overturn seas; do not underestimate it, my liege.

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: With power to subdue dragons and tigers, move mountains and overturn seas, the Ten-Thousand-Year Emperor must never be underestimated.

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: He can subdue tigers and dragons, move mountains, and empty seas. Your majesty, you can't take it lightly.

candidates.source: 哼哼 别忙叫热 这热嘛还在后头呢
candidates.target: Hmm, don't get too hot yet, the real heat is still to come.

candidates.source: 哼哼 别忙叫热 这热嘛还在后头呢
candidates.target: Hmph, don't rush to say it's hot. The real heat is still to come.

candidates.source: 哼哼 别忙叫热 这热嘛还在后头呢
candidates.target:
Heh, don't be so quick to call it hot, the real heat is yet to come. 

(Or, more colloquially: Heh, don't get excited yet, the worst is still to come.)

candidates.source: 哼哼 别忙叫热 这热嘛还在后头呢
candidates.target: Hmph. Don't shout about the heat yet. That heat is still to come.

candidates.source: 哼哼 别忙叫热 这热嘛还在后头呢
candidates.target: Heh, don't rush to say it's hot yet—the real heat is still to come.

candidates.source: 哼哼 别忙叫热 这热嘛还在后头呢
candidates.target: Hmph, don't rush to complain about the heat; it's still ahead.

candidates.source: 哼哼 别忙叫热 这热嘛还在后头呢
candidates.target: Heh, don't rush to call it hot; the heat is just coming.

candidates.source: 哼哼 别忙叫热 这热嘛还在后头呢
candidates.target: Don't bother, there will be more heat.

candidates.source: 封孙悟空为弼马温掌管御马监 下殿去吧
candidates.target: Seal Sun Wukong as the Director of the Imperial Stud, and send him down to the lower court.

candidates.source: 封孙悟空为弼马温掌管御马监 下殿去吧
candidates.target: Appoint Sun Wukong as the Director of the Imperial Stables, a minor post. Go back to the lower halls.

candidates.source: 封孙悟空为弼马温掌管御马监 下殿去吧
candidates.target: Appoint Sun Wukong as the Stable Boy in charge of the Horse Stable. You may leave the hall.

candidates.source: 封孙悟空为弼马温掌管御马监 下殿去吧
candidates.target: Appoint Sun Wukong as Keeper of the Horses, and go to the lower hall.

candidates.source: 封孙悟空为弼马温掌管御马监 下殿去吧
candidates.target: Seal Sun Wukong as the Bimawen, placing him in charge of the Imperial Stable. Descend from the hall.

candidates.source: 封孙悟空为弼马温掌管御马监 下殿去吧
candidates.target: Appoint Sun Wukong as the Master of the Imperial Stables to oversee the Imperial Stables, and now, leave the hall.

candidates.source: 封孙悟空为弼马温掌管御马监 下殿去吧
candidates.target: Appoint Sun Wukong as the Bi Ma Wen to oversee the Imperial Horse Stable; now, take your leave from the hall.

candidates.source: 封孙悟空为弼马温掌管御马监 下殿去吧
candidates.target: Appoint Sun Wukong as Keeper of the Imperial Stables. You may leave.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: Without sending a single soldier or moving a single weapon, we can bring him to heel through deception and strict control. If he refuses to submit, we can capture him on the spot.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: Without expending a single soldier or troop, lure him up here and strictly control him. If he resists control, then simply capture him on the spot.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: Without deploying a single soldier, lure him here and strictly control him. If he refuses to be controlled, simply arrest him on the spot.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: Without spending a single soldier or a single drop of effort, he was tricked into believing he was in heaven and tightly controlled; if he didn't submit to being controlled, he would be captured alive.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: Without deploying a single soldier, we shall coax him to ascend to the heavens and place him under strict supervision; should he refuse to comply, we can apprehend him on the spot.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: Without deploying a single soldier, we will coax him into submission and place him under strict control; if he refuses to comply, we will arrest him on the spot.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: Without losing a single soldier, coax him up to the heavens for strict supervision; should he refuse to obey, arrest him on the spot.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: We'll restrain the monkey here in Heaven, and it will be easy for us to capture him, if he commits crimes.

candidates.source: 那弼马温打伤了马天君 捣毁了御马监 闯出了南天门 逃回花果山去了
candidates.target: Then Pílimǎwēn injured Mǎtiānjūn, destroyed the Imperial Stud, broke through the South Heavenly Gate, and escaped back to Huāguǒshān.

candidates.source: 那弼马温打伤了马天君 捣毁了御马监 闯出了南天门 逃回花果山去了
candidates.target: That buffoon Sun Wukong injured Tiangong, destroyed the Imperial Stables, broke through the Southern Heavenly Gate, and fled back to Flower Fruit Mountain.

candidates.source: 那弼马温打伤了马天君 捣毁了御马监 闯出了南天门 逃回花果山去了
candidates.target: That mischievous monkey injured Matian Jun, destroyed the Imperial Horse Agency, broke through the Southern Heaven Gate, and fled back to Flower Fruit Mountain.

candidates.source: 那弼马温打伤了马天君 捣毁了御马监 闯出了南天门 逃回花果山去了
candidates.target: That Bi Ma Wen injured Ma Tian Jun, destroyed the Imperial Horse Guard, broke through the Southern Heavenly Gate, and fled back to Hua Guo Shan.

candidates.source: 那弼马温打伤了马天君 捣毁了御马监 闯出了南天门 逃回花果山去了
candidates.target: That Bimawen injured the Heavenly Lord of Horses, destroyed the Imperial Stable, broke through the Southern Heavenly Gate, and fled back to Flower-Fruit Mountain.

candidates.source: 那弼马温打伤了马天君 捣毁了御马监 闯出了南天门 逃回花果山去了
candidates.target: That Bi Ma Wen injured the Horse God, destroyed the Imperial Stable, breached the South Heavenly Gate, and fled back to Flower-Fruit Mountain.

candidates.source: 那弼马温打伤了马天君 捣毁了御马监 闯出了南天门 逃回花果山去了
candidates.target: Then Bi Ma Wen injured the Lord of the Heavenly Horses, smashed the Imperial Horse Registry, burst through the Southern Heavenly Gate, and fled back to Flower-Fruit Mountain.

candidates.source: 那弼马温打伤了马天君 捣毁了御马监 闯出了南天门 逃回花果山去了
candidates.target: The Stable Keeper injured the Horse General, ruined the Heavenly Stables, left through the Southern Gate, and went back to the Mountain of Flowers and Fruits.

candidates.target: Neither Nezha nor Jilingshen could gain the upper hand. I hope Your Majesty will send more troops.

candidates.target: Neither Nezha nor the Giant Spirit God could achieve victory. I implore Your Majesty to send reinforcements.

candidates.target: Nezha and Jiling Shen both cannot achieve victory. I hope Your Majesty will send more generals and soldiers.

candidates.target: Neither Nezha nor the Giant Spirit God could prevail; may Your Majesty add more troops and generals.

candidates.target: Nezha and the Mighty Magic Spirit are incapable of victory. Your Majesty, you must send more troops.

candidates.target: The immortal ladies have arrived. This lowly spirit did not go far enough to greet them. I am guilty, I am guilty.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: Respected Immortal Matrons have arrived. This humble one failed to greet you properly. I am at fault, at fault.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: Honorable immortals, your arrival is graced upon us. This humble spirit did not greet you from afar, a great offense, a great offense.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: Ladies and ladies of the divine, please enter. The little deity has not greeted you from afar. Guilty, guilty.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: The fair immortals have arrived; this humble deity failed to welcome you from afar. I am at fault, truly at fault.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: All the immortal ladies have arrived. The humble spirit has not come to greet them in person; I am at fault, truly at fault.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: May the fairies arrive! This humble deity failed to welcome you from afar; I am guilty, I am guilty.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: The goddesses are here. I didn't come to greet you, please forgive me.

candidates.target: You monkey-headed fool, your guts are awfully big—you dare to steal peaches and wine in the sky, and even steal the elixir of immortality from Laozi!

candidates.target: You mischievous monkey, your audacity knows no bounds! You dare to steal peaches and wine from the heavens, and even devour the Golden Elixir of the Old Lord Laozi!

candidates.target: You monkey-headed rascal, your audacity is no small thing! You dare steal peaches and wine from the heavens, and even devour Laojun's golden elixir.

candidates.target: You impudent monkey, your audacity is truly great! How dare you steal peaches and wine from the heavens, and even devour the Golden Pill of the Lord of the Golden Furnace!

candidates.source: 你这猴头 胆子可不小 竟敢在天上偷桃偷酒 又偷吃老君的金丹
candidates.target: You're a savage monkey to ruin the Peach Party and eat up all of Lord Lao Zi's Golden Elixir Pills.

candidates.target: Everywhere shines with golden splendor; everywhere bloom strange and exotic flowers.

candidates.target: In Heaven, everything is resplendent and magnificent and is decorated by exotic flowers.

candidates.source: 万岁真是圣明 待老臣再去哄他上天
candidates.target: Reasonable choice, Your Majesty. I'll go and trick him to Heaven again.

candidates.target: Bold monkey head! The Jade Emperor sent you to manage the horses, and you dared to release the celestial steeds!

candidates.target: It is good... but compared to the Peach Garden in Heaven... it doesn't even come close.

candidates.target: Your Majesty, let me, a poor monk, aid Erlang.

candidates.target: I am the Great Sage Equaling Heaven on this Flower-Fruit Mountain. Who dares to seal me?

candidates.target: I am the Great Sage Equal to Heaven on Flower Fruit Mountain. Who used him to seal me?

candidates.target: Up here on the fruit mountain, I am the Great Sage of Heaven. Who needs his seal?

candidates.target: On this Flower-Fruit Mountain, I am the Great Sage Equal to Heaven. Who needs their titles to define me?

candidates.target: I am the Great Sage Equal to Heaven on this Flower-Fruit Mountain; who can bestow that title upon me?

candidates.target: I am the Great Sage Equal to Heaven on this Flower-Fruit Mountain; who needs his title?

candidates.target: May the Emperor issue an edict and dispatch more troops.

candidates.target: May Your Majesty issue an edict to dispatch additional troops.

candidates.source: 望万岁降旨 再发兵将
candidates.target: Please send more troops to vanquish the monkey, Your Majesty.

candidates.source: 冒犯天威 定要捉拿问 罪
candidates.target: Offend the heavens, and you will surely be arrested and punished.

candidates.target: Offending Heaven's authority will surely result in capture and questioning for punishment.

candidates.target:
Those who offend the authority of Heaven must be arrested and punished. 

(Or, more idiomatically: Those who defy Heaven will be brought to justice.)

candidates.target: Offend the Heavens, surely arrest the culprit and bring him to justice.

candidates.target: To offend the heavenly majesty is to invite certain arrest and punishment.

candidates.target: To offend the heavenly mandate is a grave crime; we must arrest and bring him to justice.

candidates.source: 冒犯天威 定要捉拿问 罪
candidates.target: Whoever offends the imperial majesty shall be arrested and punished.

candidates.target: And when he learned he wasn't invited to the Peach Banquet, he attacked the Jade Emperor and Queen Mother with a torrent of abuse.

candidates.source: 那王母的蟠桃园 乃是天上第一仙景啊

candidates.target: You're nothing but a coward, striking from behind and shooting arrows in the dark.

candidates.source: 你们背地里下手 暗箭伤人 算不得什么好汉
candidates.target: Those who strike from behind and injure others with hidden arrows are not honorable men.

candidates.source: 你们背地里下手 暗箭伤人 算不得什么好汉
candidates.target:
You strike from the shadows and harm people with hidden arrows – you are no heroes. 

(Or, more colloquially: You stab people in the back – you're no honorable men.)

candidates.source: 你们背地里下手 暗箭伤人 算不得什么好汉
candidates.target: You strike from the shadows, behind the scenes, with secret arrows that injure people. You’re not a hero.

candidates.source: 你们背地里下手 暗箭伤人 算不得什么好汉
candidates.target: You strike from the shadows and wound with hidden arrows; that does not make you a true hero.

candidates.source: 你们背地里下手 暗箭伤人 算不得什么好汉
candidates.target: Backstabbing and striking from the shadows do not make you a true hero.

candidates.source: 你们背地里下手 暗箭伤人 算不得什么好汉
candidates.target: You act treacherously behind our backs and strike with hidden arrows; you cannot be called a true hero.

candidates.source: 你们背地里下手 暗箭伤人 算不得什么好汉
candidates.target: How despicable to stab me in the back. It's not very heroic. Humpf!

candidates.target: Better to play along with his scheme and grant him the empty title of the Great Sage Equal to Heaven.

candidates.source: 不如将计就计 就给他个齐天大圣的空名
candidates.target: Why not go along with it and give him the empty title of Great Sage Equal to Heaven?

candidates.source: 不如将计就计 就给他个齐天大圣的空名
candidates.target: Might as well play along and give him the empty title of the Great Sage Equal to Heaven.

candidates.target: If you don't follow his orders, you'll be sent to the Celestial Palace for punishment.

candidates.target: If you don't listen to him, he'll have you climb the Azure Ladder to Heaven.

candidates.target:
If he doesn't listen, I will fight my way to the Imperial Palace.

candidates.target: If not by him, then mark it with the Jade Emperor’s Palace.

candidates.target: If we do not rely on him, we shall storm the Hall of the Highest Void.

candidates.target: If you do not submit to him, he will ascend to the Heavenly Court of the Jade Emperor.

candidates.target: If you do not submit to him, I will strike you down before the Hall of Supreme Purity.

candidates.source: 若不依他 就要打上凌霄宝殿
candidates.target: If we don't accommodate him, he plans to attack the Heavenly Palace!

candidates.target: If we don't severely punish him, others will follow his example, and the heavens will be in chaos.

candidates.target: If he isn't severely punished, others will surely follow suit, and chaos will reign in the heavens.

candidates.target: If he isn't arrested and severely punished, others will follow his example, and wouldn't that throw Heaven into chaos?

candidates.target: If he isn't caught and severely punished, someone will surely learn from his example, and wouldn't that cause chaos in heaven?

candidates.source: 如不抓来严加惩办 定会有人学他 天上岂不大乱
candidates.target: If he is not apprehended and severely punished, others will surely emulate him, and chaos will surely ensue in the heavens.

candidates.source: 如不抓来严加惩办 定会有人学他 天上岂不大乱
candidates.target: If we do not arrest and severely punish him, others will surely follow his example; how can the heavens remain orderly otherwise?
